sentences.text: % 18.09.2023 [The proceeding has been conducted through Hybrid mode]
1. In terms of the previous order, the updated and corrected settlement deed executed between the petitioner and respondent No.2/complainant is placed on record.

2. Mr. Mukesh Kumar, learned APP submits that though the FIR was registered under Section 376 IPC r/w Sections 8/12 of POCSO Act, 2012, however, according to the instructions of the IO, the charges which have been framed against the petitioner are under Section 354 IPC and 10 of the POCSO Act.
3. Learned APP submits that before this Court takes any view, it would be in the interest of justice to have the order on charge placed This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/09/2023 at 21:19:26 on record.
4. Learned counsel seeks and is granted four weeks time to place on record the same.
Copy of the same be also furnished to the State.
5. In pursuance of the previous order, the minor child has also been produced in Court.
